attributes.name: Krelloort
attributes.powers:
Before you act, if there are other cards in the location deck, Krelloort is evaded; put him on the bottom of the location deck, then summon and encounter the villain Sea Devil Prince.

If you fail a check to defeat Krelloort, discard your hand.

"The treasure of Mancatcher Cave belongs to me!"—Krelloort
